excerpt.zh:
你好！我是艺术家联盟的首席大师，衷心祝愿你今天也是才思如泉涌。

我们能为您做什么？为您打造一个用于欣赏的艺术作品？或者您希望赞助我们城邦的充满异域之美的创作？
excerpt.en:
Greetings! I, the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe, wish you a creative day.

What can we do you for? Perhaps produce a work of art for you to enjoy? Or maybe you wish to sponsor our enclave in its creation of otherworldly beauty?

texts.zh:
你好！我是艺术家联盟的首席大师，衷心祝愿你今天也是才思如泉涌。

我们能为您做什么？为您打造一个用于欣赏的艺术作品？或者您希望赞助我们城邦的充满异域之美的创作？
texts.en:
Greetings! I, the headmaster of the Artisan Troupe, wish you a creative day.

What can we do you for? Perhaps produce a work of art for you to enjoy? Or maybe you wish to sponsor our enclave in its creation of otherworldly beauty?

texts.zh: 嗯？噢，请原谅，我不小心陷入了冥想状态。有时候我的这种天赋有点……太强势了。我们还有什么能够为你做的吗？
texts.en: Hm? Oh, please excuse my reverie. Sometimes this muse of mine is simply... overpowering. Is there anything else we can do for you?

texts.zh: 你是否一度为极度的壮丽而驻足惊叹？我们如此，而你们亦然。这是何等的缘分！灵感来了，我得为这写一首歌。
texts.en: Have you ever stopped to wonder at the sheer majesty of it all? Here we are, and there you are. What fantastic odds! I feel a ballad coming on.

texts.zh: 喂？你好？啊，是你！请原谅——我正好卡在了一个特别难以推敲的诗节上面。有什么事吗？
texts.en: Yes? Hello? Ah, it's you! Forgive me; I was stuck chasing a particularly elusive stanza. How can I help?

label.zh: 我们想委托创作一件艺术品。
label.en: We want to commission an art piece.

label.zh: 我们想委托创作一件艺术品。
label.en: We want to commission an art piece.

responses.zh: 很遗憾，我们不能再提供更多艺术品了，否则就相当于承认您之前买的那些并不够好。我们也要考虑自己的诚意，敬请谅解。
responses.en: Sadly we cannot offer any more, lest we come to believe that you didn't appreciate the ones you already purchased. We have our integrity to think about, you see.

label.zh: 我们想要成为你们的赞助者。
label.en: We wish to become your patron.

label.zh: 在我们所有的星球上组织一场节日盛典。
label.en: Organize a festival across our worlds.

label.zh: 我们希望你们帮忙建立一所艺术学院。
label.en: We would like your help to found an Art College.

label.zh: 我们想要投资一个文化中心。
label.en: We want to invest in a Ministry of Culture.

label.zh: 告诉我更多有关于你们艺术家联盟的信息。
label.en: Tell us more about your troupe.

responses.zh:
我们是艺术家联盟。我们联盟包括好几个空间站，里面居住着来自不同世界的艺术天才。他们渴望在这片安宁的避风港创造出真正的美。他们带来了全星系的不同思想和方法论，汇聚一堂我们或许可以发现真我的最终形态。

我们为真正的艺术爱好者提供各类服务。如果你帮助赞助我们的工作，我们甚至可能为你的人民组织更盛大的活动！
responses.en:
We are the Artisan Troupe. The troupe consists of several stations inhabited by creatives from many worlds, all unified in the desire to create new beauty in these safe havens. They bring their ideas and methods from all around the galaxy, and together we uncover the ultimate expressions of the self!

We provide many services to those who wish to enjoy art. If you help sponsor our work we might even be willing to organize larger events for your people!

texts.zh: 好极了！我们很乐意将我们的一件创作送给你们，这肯定会给你的帝国的人民带去欢乐的。
texts.en: Fabulous! We'd be glad to entrust you with one of our creations. It is sure to bring joy to the people of your empire.

tooltips.zh:
解锁一项可在殖民地实施的£decision£展出艺术纪念碑决议，并带来如下效果：
£amenities£ 舒适度 +15%
迁入吸引力：+50%
tooltips.en:
Gain access to an £decision£ Exhibit Art Monument Decision that can be enacted on a colony with the following effects:
£amenities£ Amenities +15%
Immigration Pull: +50%

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

texts.zh: 非常感谢你！噢，这样高尚的行为，势必将鼓舞更多的艺术作品现身这个宇宙。我们坚信你会十分满意的。
texts.en: Thank you so very much! Ah, such a noble act it is to help bring more art into the universe. We are confident you will be satisfied.

texts.zh: 因为你今日的所作所为，星辰神龛今天闪耀得更加明亮了！
texts.en: The stars shine that bit more brightly by your actions here today!

texts.zh: 我们知道你们[root.GetSpeciesAdj]存在与众不同之处。讲真，你们一族真是太可口了。
texts.en: We knew there was something special about you [root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Truly, you are beings of refined taste.

texts.zh: 这将对我们大有裨益，我们可以尝试新的想法，还能在创作的过程中承担更多的风险。我们有一个历时十年的项目，但是需要一次性事前支付。
texts.en: That would be very helpful, allowing us to try new ideas and take more risks in our creation process. We have a ten year program with a one-time up-front cost.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

texts.zh: 非常感谢你们！有了你们慷慨的捐助，我们就能更好的扩展艺术的概念了！当然，我们也会给所有的赞助者们按时发放进度通讯。
texts.en: Thank you very much! Now, with your generous contribution, we will be able to expand on the concept of art itself! We will of course also send out a regular newsletter to all patrons.

texts.zh: 这里是我们为诸位赞助者提供的最新简讯：
texts.en: Here follows the latest newsletter for all our patrons:

texts.zh:
很不幸城邦中最近没能产出什么作品。大部分的艺术家都深陷忧郁之中，皆因难以迸发出创作的灵感。这种情绪十分棘手，但也有益处。毕竟创作还是要花一定时间的。

任何为了帮助这些艺术家重燃创作之火而进行的赞助，都能大大改进我们目前的创作窘境。
texts.en:
Sadly nothing much has been produced in the enclave. Most of the artists have fallen into a deep melancholy from where no inspiration can be drawn. The mood is dire, but hopeful. Creation takes time, after all.

Any donations that might help the group rekindle their interest in the material plane would be of tremendous help.

texts.zh:
整个城邦最近几个月里甚是忙碌。我们的厅堂因为居民发明的新技术而议论纷纷，这项技术能够向使用者传播嗅觉。这个非凡的器械注定能改变一切。

为了进一步发展这个想法我们需要更多的捐助。
texts.en:
The enclave has been busy the last couple of months. Our halls are abuzz with a new kind of technology invented by a resident, capable of transmitting sensations of smell to a user. This remarkable piece of machinery will surely change everything.

In order to further develop this idea we will require more donations.

texts.zh:
协会最近一直处于欢脱的氛围之中。嗅媒感知设备的发明使得一个又一个艺术家将其重心转移到为其创造全新体验上。到目前为止，他们的工作所取得的最佳成果是一首通过嗅觉信号传递的管弦乐曲。

我们的工作还在继续，同时十分乐意接受任何形式的捐助。
texts.en:
The enclave is in a frisky mood. The creation of the Scentilus Rift has caused many an artist to shift their primary focus to creating new experiences for it. So far the most noteworthy to come out of this endeavor is an orchestral piece conveyed via scent.

Our work continues and any donations would be gladly accepted.

texts.zh:
我们已经放弃继续创建以气味为中心的媒介了。这是个拙劣的想法，除了浪费时间并让室内布满臭气之外，没有任何意义。

为了能重新回到正确的创作之路，我们需要你们的赞助，我们感谢你们的继续支持！
texts.en:
We have abandoned the attempts to create scent-centered media. It was a foolish idea and has brought nothing but wasted time and unpleasant odors.

In order to find our way back again we will need donations from our trusted patrons. We thank you for your continued support!

label.zh: 我们现在担负不起这个价格。
label.en: We cannot afford to donate now.

label.zh: 我们希望取消简讯订阅。
label.en: We wish to unsubscribe from this newsletter.

texts.zh: 赞助者，我们听到这个消息真是出离地抱歉！没有时事通讯，我们就无法向你传达我们最近的成果……
texts.en: We are exceptionally sorry to hear that, o patron! Without the newsletter we won't be able to keep you up-to-date on our latest accomplishments...

texts.zh:
你好，赞助人[Root.GetRulerName]！我们构想出了一种华丽的新型建筑，专门用来促进人们之间的互相理解——文化中心。它的功能得益于融合了大众对彼此的潜意识偏见和艺术的偏好，然后粉碎了这些并以一种新的统一形式呈现出来。

你们想不想购买这个建筑？这一定会对你们帝国的紧密连接起到作用。如果要我自己来说的话，这可是优惠价！
texts.en:
Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]! We have come up with a gorgeous new type of architecture, specifically tuned to improve crowds' understanding of one another - a Ministry of Culture. It functions thanks to a mix of using the populace's subconscious bias against each other and art, then smashing it all and presenting a new form of unity.

Would you like to purchase this building? It will surely prove useful to binding your empire together. And it's a bargain, if I may say so myself!

texts.zh: 我们十分抱歉，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人：我们很不幸陷入了创作的瓶颈期。整个城邦目前还处于紊乱的状态，尚不能提供任何成果。一如既往，我们仍然十分感谢您的赞助。
texts.en: We apologize, patron [Root.GetRulerName]: we have sadly reached something of a creative roadblock. The enclave is in disarray and we have nothing to offer at this time. We thank you for your patronage, as always.

texts.zh: 您好，来自[Root.GetRulerName]的赞助人。由于一个重大故障，我们最近不得不报废掉大多数的技术设备。您是否能用得上其中所产生的零件或原料呢？
texts.en: Greetings, patron [Root.GetRulerName]. We have recently been forced to scrap most of our technical equipment due to a major malfunction. Would the materials and scrap be of any use to you, by any chance?

label.zh: 我们会帮助你们修理的。
label.en: We will repair it for you.

texts.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetRulerName][Root.GetRulerTitle]：十年前[Root.GetName]承诺赞助艺术家联盟，并已如约履行。

上一期的赞助已经接近尾声，谨慎起见请允许我们再度询问：您是否愿意续订全星系最精美的艺术和工艺品？
texts.en:
Esteemed [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]: a decade ago the [Root.GetName] pledged to support the Artisan Troupe, and so you have.

The time of your patronage is coming to an end, but it would be remiss of us not to ask: would you care to renew your subscription to the finest arts and crafts in the galaxy?

texts.zh: 举办这等规模的星球盛典，那需要我们所有的艺术家都使出浑身解数。不是一件容易的工作。
texts.en: Organizing a festival of that scale would require all of our artists to bring their talent to bear. Not an easy job, nor a cheap one.

texts.zh: 很好！我们很乐意为你举办这伟大的星球盛典！
texts.en: Excellent! We will be delighted to create this magnificent Festival of Worlds!

texts.zh: 由于星球盛典所带来的浓厚的快乐氛围，一些盛典的举办者们爱上了我们的生活方式。他们声称希望节日过后能够留下来；在此定居，成为我们帝国的一员。
texts.en: Due to the overabundance of happiness being spread by the Festival of Worlds, some of the event's organizers have begun to fall in love with our way of life. They claim they wish to remain here; to settle down and become a part of our empire.

texts.zh:
艺术家联盟主办的星球盛典，曾经一度，给[Root.GetName]的人们带去了欢乐。哎呀，这样的事情注定不会长久。

在[this_planet.GetName]上，节日活动引发了人群的大规模踩踏事件，致使数千名公民死亡。目前尚不清楚究竟是怎样的情况导致了这一出家破人亡的惨剧，但是人民对于我们的政府和盛典主办方的怨恨与日俱增。
texts.en:
The Festival of Worlds organized by the Artisan Troupe had, for a time, brought joy to the people of the [Root.GetName]. Alas, it was not meant to last.

On [this_planet.GetName], festival activities have resulted in a huge crowd stampeding and killing thousands of citizens. It is not clear what circumstances led to this tragic loss of life, but there is now growing resentment towards our administration and the festival's organizers alike.

texts.zh:
星球盛典突然停止了。艺术家联盟已经收拾好行李离开了，一句解释都没有。

我们彻底搜索他们的营地和演出舞台后发现，大量存放的资源已经消失。
texts.en:
The Festival of Worlds has abruptly stopped. The Artisan Troupe has packed their bags and left, without saying a word about why.

Thorough searches of their campsites and arenas have revealed only that a substantial quantity of resources has disappeared.

tooltips.zh: 艺术家联盟在10年内拒收任何通讯。
tooltips.en: The Artisan Troupe will refuse any communique for 10 years.

tooltips.zh: 原谅艺术家联盟的违约行为。
tooltips.en: The Artisan Troupe are forgiven for their transgressions.

tooltips.zh: 艺术家联盟在10年内拒收任何通讯。
tooltips.en: The Artisan Troupe will refuse any communique for 10 years.

texts.zh: 太巧了！我们正打算提出和你说的基本类似的提议！如果你将此设施建设在与我们共享星系的[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]里，我们将派遣我们最优秀的艺术家前去当教师。
texts.en: Brilliant! We were just about to suggest the very same thing to you! If you establish this institution on the [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] in the system you share with us, we shall send some of our finest artists to serve there as teachers.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以在[artist_system.GetName]星系建造艺术学院这一[GetStarbaseOrWayStation]建筑了。
tooltips.en: We can now build the Art College [GetStarbaseOrWayStation] Building in the [artist_system.GetName] system.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以在[artist_system.GetName]星系建造艺术学院驿站模块了。
tooltips.en: We can now build the Art College Waystation Module in the [artist_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 啊，文化中心……它的任务就是挑战与常理背道而驰的观念，提升你帝国内艺术的凝聚力。让我来说，完全就是一个杰作。
texts.en: Ah, the Ministry of Culture... It was designed to challenge divergent ideas and promote greater unity throughout your empire through the medium of art. A true masterpiece, if I may say so myself.
